description: This file is a JavaScript source file that extends the Ext JS library, specifically providing an adapter for jQuery integration within Ext JS 3.4.0. It defines various utility functions, class extensions, and region/point calculations related to Ext JS and jQuery interactions.

classes.name: Ext
classes.description: Main Ext JS namespace with version info and utility functions.

classes.name: Ext.lib.Dom
classes.description: Provides DOM-related utility functions for view dimensions, element position, and event handling.

classes.name: Ext.lib.Region
classes.description: Represents rectangular regions with methods for containment, intersection, union, and constraints.

classes.name: Ext.lib.Point
classes.description: Represents a point, inheriting from Region, with x and y coordinates.

methods.name: Ext.apply
methods.description: Copies properties from source objects to a target object.

methods.name: Ext.applyIf
methods.description: Copies properties from source to target only if they are undefined in target.

methods.name: Ext.extend
methods.description: Creates a subclass of a class.

methods.name: Ext.get
methods.description: Retrieves an Ext Element by id.

methods.name: Ext.getDom
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element from an Ext Element or id.

methods.name: Ext.fly
methods.description: Gets a flyweight Ext Element for quick DOM manipulation.
